_comment: The r1007 network cut (0.5.3, CORE-N1/N2): the ONE file holding every value the r1007 genesis produces that this build pins. A value not known yet is null, with what sets it in `pending`; it is never a placeholder. `scripts/network-cut.py check` (CI) keeps this file well formed; `scripts/network-cut.py apply` refuses while anything is pending, and once every value is set writes them to src-tauri/network/profiles.json (the r1007 profile, including its rpcUrl (on a host in `rpcHosts`, verified live by `check --release`) and the nodeCheckpoint values rendered into the member node.toml, its nodeGenesisProfiles entry, `active`, `retired` on the profiles in `retire`), scripts/build-sidecar.sh (MIN_CHAIN_REV), release/components.json (the citrate-node rev and its three per-target pins), src-tauri/runtime-deps.sha256 (the macOS and Linux aarch64 node pins and each node build's PROVENANCE record, a runtime-deps asset next to its bytes) and src-tauri/Cargo.toml + kit/Cargo.toml (the app's citrate-chain crate revs). `check --release` (run by scripts/check-network-profile.sh --release while r1007 is active) fails until the cut is complete and applied. Runbook: docs/release/053-NETWORK.md.

retire.r1006: replaced by r1007 in 0.5.3; a 0.5.2 node data dir on r1006 is set aside as chain.r1006.bak

notBuilt.aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu: owner 2026-11-12: 0.5.3 ships macOS and Linux x86_64 only; Linux aarch64 is not built, and the updater feed has no linux-aarch64 entry (an aarch64 install is offered no update)

pending.genesisHash: block 0 of the r1007 genesis commit, read from the first producer after S4-1 (planset 05 S4-1) and agreed by every fleet node
pending.genesisProfile: the [chain] genesis_profile name the r1007 node compiles for that block 0 (citrate-chain node/src/genesis.rs at chainRev)
pending.compiledActivations: whether the r1007 genesis compiles its ValidatorRegistry and activation height (citrate-chain genesis::resolve_validator_registry at chainRev); true means the app passes no CITRATE_VALIDATOR_* override
pending.chainParams: the chain parameters the citrate-chain node at chainRev compiles for the r1007 block 0 (core/consensus/src/genesis_params.rs, the r1007 entry of GENESIS_CHAIN_PARAMS; the node logs them at start-up as `Genesis chain parameters: ...`), all 13 by the node's field names: slot_duration_secs, max_future_drift_secs, pruning_depth, undo_window, ghostdag_k, max_parents, merge_depth, checkpoint_interval, committee_size, checkpoint_vote_depth, include_gas_limit, accept_gas_limit, validator_activation_height. Recorded by the chain lead from the integrated genesis commit (S4-1). The node refuses to start when the node config's [checkpoint] interval, committee_size or vote_depth differ from checkpoint_interval, committee_size and checkpoint_vote_depth, so apply writes those three into the profile's nodeCheckpoint (rendered into node.toml); undo_window must not exceed the profile's memberPruneRetain
pending.rpcUrl: the public JSON-RPC of the r1007 fleet (S4-2, the chain/devops lead), on a host in rpcHosts (rpc.citrate.ai, the host the fleet keeps across networks, plus any r1007 fleet host S4-2 names, added there first). `check --release` asks it for eth_chainId (40204) and eth_getBlockByNumber 0x0 (genesisHash) and fails closed; the app checks both again before any signature. apply writes it into the r1007 profile
pending.bootnodes: the Noise static keys of boot1.citrate.ai, boot2.citrate.ai, boot3.citrate.ai and rpc.citrate.ai on the r1007 fleet (S4-2), each @<host>:30303
pending.addressBookSha256: sha256 of the canonical address book exported after the r1007 genesis contract deploy (S4-3), the file scripts/sync-addresses.py keeps as src-tauri/addresses/40204.canonical.json
pending.chainRev: the citrate-chain r1007 genesis commit (40 hex), tagged and signed at S4-1; becomes MIN_CHAIN_REV, the citrate-node source rev and the app's citrate-chain crate rev, and must be on public citrate-chain for the app's git dependencies
pending.consensusFingerprint: `citrate --config <the rendered r1007 node.toml> consensus --json` fingerprint of the node built at chainRev (0x + 32 hex); the cold-sync acceptance (N6) checks the running node reports it in citrate_nodeIdentity
pending.node.aarch64-apple-darwin: the release Mac: scripts/build-sidecar.sh --print-digest at chainRev, uploaded to the runtime-deps prerelease as citrate-aarch64-apple-darwin-<chainRev 12>; {runtime_deps_asset, sha256, evidence, provenance: {asset: citrate-aarch64-apple-darwin-<chainRev 12>.PROVENANCE.txt, sha256}}; the PROVENANCE record is uploaded to runtime-deps next to the node bytes
pending.node.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu: citrate-core-linux-build: the fixed-asset recipe in docs/RELEASE_LINUX.md at chainRev (reproducible per core#586 once merged); {sha256, evidence, provenance: {asset: citrate-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-<chainRev 12>.PROVENANCE.txt, sha256}}; the PROVENANCE record is uploaded to runtime-deps next to the node bytes
